entries.summary: Registry 3.11.0 changes matchday.lineup to v4. A confidence downgrade now floors at low, and unknown team news no longer lowers selection confidence; unknown means no estimate, not one level below low. Selection scores, picks, formation and availability counts are unchanged. The panel now shows slots filled and team-news known/unknown counts beside the estimate.
entries.title: Selection confidence no longer erases at low

entries.summary: Registry 3.12.0 adds usa:mls to the scouting pool. MLS uses the current calendar year, and its Western and Eastern conference tables are retained; team rank and PPG percentile are within each conference, while player percentiles remain within the full MLS cohort. No cohort rule or ranking changed; MLS players are compared within MLS only.
entries.title: Major League Soccer added to the scouting universe

entries.summary: /matchday/ carries a How to watch card and /matches/ and /fixtures/ carry Watch labels. Domestic and international are separate; confirmed outlets require an official club or SPFL source, Saturday 15:00 is labelled as a UK blackout window, and other uncurated slots stay not announced. No price, stream URL or article body is published.
entries.title: How to watch, with region and unknown states

entries.summary: Registry 3.10.0 adds the canonical entity index and page metadata, publishes claims on /claims/ instead of the retired /themes/ route, and splits the scouting search payload into meta plus four shards. No published value, formula, denominator or source precedence changed; the scouting pool and claim counts are the same records.
entries.title: Search, claims and the reader-first semantic layer

entries.summary: The unknowns register, guarded comparison panel, ten-family depth chart, sale chain and Cormack-era lookup are live. Every view reads published records; the cohort exclusion is enforced by player id and no published metric value changed. Current-squad comparison is limited to the reviewed comparison crosswalk.
entries.title: Unknowns, comparison, depth, sale chain and era lookup

entries.summary: Every active registered metric and every curated concept now has one definition at /glossary/, with its formula, unit, basis, coverage, source layer and registry version. Page provenance links each metric name to its entry. No value or definition changed.
entries.title: Glossary and definitions published

entries.summary: API-Football fills a missing current-season result for every SPFL tier, never overriding an existing football-data score. Registry 3.9.0 adds the provider league ids and the result guard.
entries.title: Complete current-season league results

entries.summary: The matchday lineup metric version 3 and registry 3.9.1 enable the opponent player-statistics stage, so the opponent XI carries the same provider recent-rating field as Aberdeen. No formula changed.
entries.title: Opponent match ratings in the predicted XI

entries.summary: The 2026-10-24 Dundee United 3-2 Aberdeen result appeared on the fixture pages but not in the league table, form guide, analysis hero, history record or club summary. The official SPFL overlay now writes a complete league result row, and every table-driven surface reads the same canonical result frame.
entries.title: The Dundee United result was missing from the table and form

entries.summary: Registry 3.8.0 corrects the omitted official result, adds the canonical results layer, and adds the refresh, consistency and epoch guards. This is a correctness correction, not a formula change.
entries.title: Refresh integrity and canonical results

entries.summary: Duplicate records are aliases of the canonical match and are excluded from counts, search and navigation.
entries.title: Duplicate pre-season fixtures inflated the match record

entries.summary: The read now says the event feed is unavailable and does not print a zero.
entries.title: An unavailable event feed was described as zero goals

entries.summary: The late-win phrase now requires a one-goal margin and a decisive late goal; multi-goal defeats no longer receive it.
entries.title: Heavy defeats were headlined as late wins

entries.summary: The review states the measured finish: 10th on 41 points, in the bottom six.
entries.title: A season review described a relegation fight without the measured record

entries.summary: The final was labelled FA Cup and described as a draw. Competition labels now resolve through the competition registry, and the shootout outcome is named in the headline, H1 and honours record.
entries.title: The 2024-25 Scottish Cup final was labelled FA Cup

entries.summary: All fixture and player competition labels now use the canonical Scottish Cup name.
entries.title: Scottish Cup fixtures carried the provider label FA Cup

entries.summary: Second yellows are derived from prior yellow-card events and shown as a second yellow.
entries.title: A second yellow was shown as a straight red

entries.summary: Unknown availability is null and labelled unknown; opponent availability is not modelled.
entries.title: Unknown availability was rendered as zero

note: Report a factual error through the public issue tracker. Include the page, the claim and a source. Corrections are recorded with the date, the affected page and the status.
